senses.example: Jeg kom til stationen for sent i morges.
senses.example_translation: I got to the station too late this morning.

senses.example: Jeg siger til, hvis jeg kommer for sent.
senses.example_translation: I'll let you know if I'm late.

senses.example: Han lovede at lade være med at ryge.
senses.example_translation: He promised not to smoke.

senses.example: Vi tager til stranden i morgen.
senses.example_translation: We are going to the beach tomorrow.

senses.example: Bilen tager til i fart på motorvejen.
senses.example_translation: The car increases speed on the highway.

senses.example: Vil du gå med til festen på lørdag?
senses.example_translation: Would you like to come along to the party on Saturday?

senses.example: Hun gik med en rød kjole i går.
senses.example_translation: She wore a red dress yesterday.

senses.example: Hun gik på universitetet i tre år.
senses.example_translation: She attended university for three years.

senses.example: Hun gik ind i huset uden at banke på.
senses.example_translation: She went into the house without knocking.

senses.example: Regnen gav sig endelig sidst på dagen.
senses.example_translation: The rain finally eased up at the end of the day.

senses.example: Han gav sig til sidst og sagde ja.
senses.example_translation: He finally gave in and said yes.

senses.example: Jeg er nødt til at gå nu.
senses.example_translation: I have to go now.

senses.example: Tænk dig en verden uden biler.
senses.example_translation: Imagine a world without cars.

senses.example: Katten sidder på stolen hele dagen.
senses.example_translation: The cat sits on the chair all day.

senses.text: to keep (information, a secret) to oneself
senses.example: Hun sad på hemmeligheden i mange år.
senses.example_translation: She kept the secret for many years.

senses.example: Tænk dig at bo i sådan et hus.
senses.example_translation: Imagine living in such a house.

senses.example: Han spiller på guitar hver aften.
senses.example_translation: He plays the guitar every evening.

senses.example: Jeg skriver til min ven hver uge.
senses.example_translation: I write to my friend every week.

senses.example: Mødet står på i to timer.
senses.example_translation: The meeting lasts for two hours.

senses.example: Jeg har lyst til en kop te.
senses.example_translation: I feel like a cup of tea.

senses.example: Vi gik ned ad trappen til stuen.
senses.example_translation: We walked down the stairs to the living room.

senses.example: Solen går ned klokken otte om aftenen.
senses.example_translation: The sun sets at eight o'clock in the evening.

senses.example: Prisen på mælk er gået ned i denne uge.
senses.example_translation: The price of milk has gone down this week.

senses.example: Jeg slog mig på knæet, da jeg faldt.
senses.example_translation: I hurt my knee when I fell.

senses.example: Vi rejser til Spanien hver sommer.
senses.example_translation: We travel to Spain every summer.

senses.example: Mange tror, at spøgelser er til.
senses.example_translation: Many people believe that ghosts exist.

senses.example: Vandet blev til is i løbet af natten.
senses.example_translation: The water turned to ice during the night.
